baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated focus verbs 'we hear or we reason' govern the counterfactual negation of being among the companions of the blaze.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hearing supplies receptive understanding and compliance, while reason supplies discriminating restraint from folly. The two are alternative but convergent interruption points in a causal sequence that otherwise settles into enduring association with an ignited fire.

activation_trace.role: Understanding joined to acceptance and compliance makes hearing the receptive entry point that could have altered conduct.
The intelligence that restrains from ignorance supplies the second possible brake on the same course.
Occurrence and presence in time bind the two counterfactual states: having responded then and not being present in this company now.
Companionship as sustained association turns the result into a settled affiliation rather than a momentary encounter.
Ignition and burning give the terminal association its concrete destructive condition.

changed_reading.before: They regret lacking auditory or intellectual capacity.
changed_reading.after: They diagnose two missed forms of accountable response, receptive compliance and self-restraint, either of which could have interrupted the course that made them enduring associates of the blaze.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus begins with 'they said' and embeds a first-person counterfactual judgment about their own hearing and reasoning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance does more than report pain: voiced speech externalizes a newly held belief about the speakers' former epistemic failure. Their present proposition therefore performs a self-indicting revision of stance.

activation_trace.role: Speech brought out in articulation makes the diagnosis public and inspectable.
Speech as belief or position lets the utterance register a changed conviction, not merely a cry.
Comprehension, acceptance, and compliance name the receptive failure now admitted.
Discriminating restraint names the internal corrective the speakers now judge themselves not to have exercised.

changed_reading.before: The verse quotes a conventional expression of regret.
changed_reading.after: The verse records a spoken replacement belief: the speakers finally articulate the epistemic and volitional diagnosis they had failed to adopt when it could still redirect them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus contrasts the unrealized work of hearing and reason with realized companionship in the blaze.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of reason images a refuge, while a branch of companionship images preservation through accompaniment. Together they permit a spatial-social inversion: receptive reason could have functioned as protective company and shelter, but its absence ends in company with the destructive fire.

activation_trace.role: Accepted understanding supplies access to the unrealized protective course.
Reason's branch image as refuge or fortress materializes the protection that the counterfactual says was missed.
Preservation through accompaniment provides the protective social relation that is inverted by companionship with fire.
The ignited blaze occupies the place of the shelter that receptive reason might have supplied.

changed_reading.before: Listening and reasoning are abstract faculties that would have avoided punishment.
changed_reading.after: Receptive reason appears as missed protective company and refuge, sharply inverted when the speakers become the fire's companions instead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first makes the condemned physically hear the fire while it boils and audibly expresses rage. This separates bare auditory registration, which they possess too late, from the receptive understanding and compliance named by their counterfactual.

activation_trace.role: Understanding that issues in acceptance and compliance is the kind of hearing whose absence they regret.
Literal perception of sound supplies a grim control case: they hear the fire now without gaining the timely hearing they lacked.
Boiling and surging make the heard object an active, eruptive punishment.
Rage made audible links the fire's violence specifically to unavoidable hearing.
The ignited fire is both the company they enter and the sound source they can no longer avoid.

structural_cues: 67:7 gives physical hearing an explicit object before 67:10 names the hearing they failed to exercise.
The sequence moves from forced sensation to retrospective self-diagnosis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal hearing, boiling, audible rage, and later regret; I supply the temporal-ethical inversion that contrasts too-late sensation with timely receptive obedience. A live alternative is that the repeated hearing root is only lexical recurrence, but its close sequence and changed object make the contrast unusually strong.

changed_reading.before: They simply wish they had heard the warning.
changed_reading.after: They now hear punishment perfectly; what they lacked was hearing that receives and complies before coercive sound makes recognition unavoidable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the speakers admit that an awakening warning arrived, then recount their denial and their voiced accusation that the warners were badly astray. The focus utterance reverses both that speech act and its allocation of error.

activation_trace.role: Speech as a held position makes the focus statement a replacement stance.
Understanding and compliance identify what their response to the warning should have been.
Discriminating restraint relocates the failure from the warners to the speakers themselves.
A warning designed to awaken caution establishes that actionable notice actually arrived.
Contradiction of truth names their active rejection rather than a passive lack of information.
Their earlier articulated claim supplies the speech that the focus utterance retracts in effect.
Straying from guidance is the charge they had assigned outward and now implicitly assign to their own failed judgment.

structural_cues: The adversative admission 'yes, a warner came' precedes a recital of denial and accusation.
The first-person plural remains stable across the denial and the counterfactual confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival of warning, denial, prior accusatory speech, and the adjacent confession; I infer that the later statement reallocates error to the speakers and retracts their former stance. It could remain a general regret, but adjacency and shared speakers make the reversal more specific.

changed_reading.before: They acknowledge in general that they should have used their faculties.
changed_reading.after: They reverse a recorded denial: the warners were not the ones in great error; their own refusal to receive and restrain judgment was.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames life and death as a test that reveals intentional action, then names hearing and inward hearts among furnished capacities while marking little gratitude. The focus therefore evaluates not possession of faculties but their enacted, grateful use under trial.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as comprehension and compliance supplies the responsive use of the endowed faculty.
Reason as discriminating restraint supplies the inward governance by which a test changes action.
Testing that exposes a condition turns later regret into the revealed result of a trial.
Intentional action establishes conduct, rather than faculty possession, as the test's operative output.
The expressly furnished capacity for auditory perception shows that the speakers were not simply unequipped.
The inward, fire-like heart supplies an interior center alongside hearing for processing and orientation.
Recognition of a benefit and praise of its giver define the missing responsive use of those furnished capacities.

structural_cues: 67:2 makes tested action the surah's opening evaluative frame.
67:23 lists hearing, sight, and hearts as given capacities and closes with scant gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test that reveals action, an endowed hearing faculty, inward hearts, and little gratitude; I infer that a faculty counts within the test through responsive use. The alternative is that the test and gratitude frames remain general and do not define the specific counterfactual.

changed_reading.before: The speakers lacked sufficient sensory or mental equipment.
changed_reading.after: Their equipment was given and tested; the failure was to convert hearing and inward discrimination into grateful, intentional response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse classifies the focus utterance as admission, names its object as culpability, and immediately repeats the companions-of-the-blaze designation under a formula of expulsion. This converts a hypothetical-sounding sentence into the recognition that fixes their present status.

activation_trace.role: The articulated utterance is the event that the following verse classifies.
Sustained association supplies the status the speakers recognize in the focus.
The burning fire names the company to which their admission now locates them.
Admission that acknowledges and yields explicitly identifies the speech as confession.
Culpability gives the confession a moral object rather than leaving it as tactical regret.
Distance and banishment turn the recognized status into exclusion rather than a route back.
The exact companionship relation is repeated to ratify the focus speakers' self-location.
Repeated ignition closes the confession by naming the same terminal company.

structural_cues: 67:11 begins with a consequence marker and refers back to the immediately preceding utterance.
The phrase 'companions of the blaze' recurs verbatim at the end of both verses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate admission, culpability, banishment, and exact phrase repetition; I infer that 67:11 authoritatively classifies 67:10 as culpable confession and status recognition. The live alternative is that the admission summarizes the wider exchange rather than this sentence alone.

changed_reading.before: The counterfactual is an emotional wish that might seek mitigation.
changed_reading.after: It is a culpable confession whose insight arrives only as their enduring membership is named and ratified.

context_deltas.mechanism: The successful counterpart fears with reverence while the object remains hidden and receives concealment of fault and recompense. This locates the decisive work of hearing and reason before direct sensory confirmation: report and inward judgment must guide conduct during absence, not after sight and sound compel assent.

activation_trace.role: Receptive understanding and compliance let an heard warning govern action without direct inspection of its outcome.
Discriminating restraint supplies inward governance while the warned reality remains unseen.
Reverent fear provides the context's positive behavioral response to warning.
Concealment from the eyes specifies that the positive response precedes direct verification.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer supplies the avoided negative consequence of timely response.
Recompense for work confirms that unseen response has an enacted and evaluated outcome.

structural_cues: The positive counterpart follows immediately after confession and is marked by response in the unseen.
Punitive direct sensation in 67:7-10 contrasts with reverence before sight in 67:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reverent fear in concealment, protection from fault, and recompense; I infer that this is the timely counterpart to the focus speakers' too-late hearing and reasoning. The alternative is that 67:12 introduces an independent group without defining the failed process in 67:10.

changed_reading.before: They needed stronger evidence before accepting the warning.
changed_reading.after: The required success was to let heard warning and inward restraint operate while the outcome was unseen; waiting for coercive confirmation made both faculties belated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later secret-or-public speech construction collapses the difference between unvoiced and voiced positions under knowledge of their inward source. It sharpens the focus saying as disclosure: the belief now spoken was legible at its interior origin even before articulation.

activation_trace.role: Speech as belief lets the confession expose a position, not merely emit sound.
Hiding something inward supplies the unvoiced side of the disclosure contrast.
A saying held in the self before outward expression bridges inward position and voiced confession.
Public declaration and raised voice supply the outward side realized in 'they said.'
Disclosure to the knower removes concealment as protection for either form of speech.
The inward source from which actions issue locates the confession's belief before it becomes language.

structural_cues: 67:13 coordinates concealed speech and declared speech as equally known.
The focus marks the same group's interior revision with an explicit speech verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed speech, public speech, knowledge, and an inward source; I infer that the focus confession dramatizes movement from interior stance to exposed utterance. The alternative is that 67:13 states general omniscience without retrospective reference to this confession.

changed_reading.before: Their statement merely communicates regret to an external hearer.
changed_reading.after: Their spoken regret exposes an inwardly sourced replacement belief; voicing it changes publicity, not its prior availability to divine knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence asks when the threatened appointment will occur, answers with the limits of warning, and then presents the object as seen at close range. That sequence retroactively sharpens the focus's doubled 'we were': rejected future warning becomes irreversible present status, and only then generates a counterfactual past.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time hold together the unrealized earlier response and the realized later membership.
The articulated counterfactual is the retrospective speech produced once time can no longer be reopened.
An appointment bounded by time or place supplies the future event whose timing the deniers challenge.
Warning that should awaken caution defines the only timely function available before the event arrives.
Direct seeing converts what had been warned into an undeniable present object.
Rapid movement into nearness closes the temporal distance on which denial had relied.

structural_cues: 67:25 asks for the time of the promise, while 67:27 abruptly makes it seen and near.
The focus uses two past-state forms inside an irreversible counterfactual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a challenged appointment, warning, direct sight, nearness, and the focus's doubled past-state construction; I infer a surah-level temporal arc in which deferred warning becomes present fact and produces retrospective grammar. The alternative is that the later scene repeats the theme without controlling the earlier confession's temporal force.

changed_reading.before: The counterfactual is a free-standing wish about an earlier choice.
changed_reading.after: It is the grammar generated when a deferred warning has become present status: the only remaining mental route runs backward into an unreal past.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary verbal sense of 'we reason' is stronger than the root branch of tongue restraint. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the immediately preceding voiced falsehood; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary branch resonance, never as the lexical translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places speech before 'we hear or we reason,' immediately after the speakers recount their own false utterance.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech anchors the possibility that the admitted failure involved what they let themselves say.
Restraint or inhibition of the tongue supplies an unusual secondary sense of the corrective they failed to exercise.
The prior articulated accusation gives tongue-restraint a concrete target.
Falsehood identifies why withholding or checking that speech could have changed the course.

changed_reading.before: Reasoning is only an internal cognitive operation they neglected.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch resonance, reason also checks the tongue: had they received the warning or restrained the false accusation, the path to membership might have been interrupted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is branch-distant because fetters and camel-tethers are not the surface meanings of the two focus verbs. It remains visibly anchored in the hearing, reason, companionship, and blaze roots and produces a coherent reversal; downstream prose should call it an image-level activation rather than a philological gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The unrealized hearing-and-reason pair is set directly against realized attachment to the companions of the blaze.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of a fetter materializes hearing as one possible constraint on destructive motion.
Tethering an animal supplies the parallel image of self-restraint that was not applied.
Making something accompany another converts failed preventive binding into imposed attachment.
The ignited blaze becomes the destructive object of that involuntary attachment.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts failed cognition with a separate punishment.
changed_reading.after: At the level of material analogy, the restraints they did not internalize return as compulsory attachment: failure to bind themselves against error ends in being bound into the fire's company.

strongest_changes: The condemned already hear the fire, so the missed hearing is receptive compliance rather than auditory capacity.
The focus confession reverses their immediately preceding denial and relocates the charge of error onto themselves.
The following admission and repeated companions-of-the-blaze phrase fix the utterance as culpable status recognition.
The surah's test, endowed faculties, and unseen positive counterpart make timely enacted use, not mere possession or late certainty, decisive.
The later movement from challenged promise to near sight gives the doubled counterfactual a closed temporal horizon.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is an epistemic reversal staged through sound: those who refused warning can hear punishment, voice the diagnosis they once denied, and understand only when hearing and reason can no longer alter their companionship.
remaining_uncertainties: The coordination 'hear or reason' may mark two independent routes, a receptive-to-reflective sequence, or rhetorical near-equivalence.
The missed-refuge, tongue-restraint, and material-binding readings are branch activations and should not displace the ordinary senses of hearing and reasoning.
The degree to which 67:25-27 retroactively determines the temporal force of 67:10 remains inferential.
